title: Azhagarsamy
desc: Thayama gets money from a landlord in order to save her husband and promises to give her child in return. Things turn for the worst when the rich man wants to marry off his daughter to Thayama's son.

title: Sri Vinayagar Vijayam
desc: Follow the life and incredible story of Lord Ganesha from his childhood to his divinity, recounting famous mythological events that lead to his rise as a revered deity and remover of obstacles.

title: Asuran
desc: Amidst the chaos of a criminal constantly evading the police and a woman's love affair with an agricultural officer, something sinister brews that affects everyone's life.

title: Idhaya Thamarai
desc: Vijay, a short-tempered man, falls in love with Manju. However, he is imprisoned after an incident and upon his release, he learns about Manju's marriage.

title: Doss
desc: Rajeshwari and Antony, a young couple, have major class differences. She decides to elope after father kills her sister for marrying a man from a lower caste.
